title: 第4章 打工就能成神？
novel_title: 我都天庭临时工了，才神话复苏？(鬼懿)
content_zh: 白光散去，一股熟悉的潮湿霉味儿钻进鼻腔。隔壁情侣隐约的争吵声、楼上冲马桶的哗啦水流声、还有老旧冰箱压缩机运作时那像拖拉机一样的嗡嗡声。瞬间将那种神圣而压抑的史诗感冲刷得干干净净。叶凛坐在那张只要翻身就会咯吱作响的单人床上，恍如隔世。环顾四周，不到十平米的廉价出租屋，墙皮脱落，但打理得还算干净。他下意识地摸了摸自已的脖子。还活着呢。叶凛长出一口气，掏出手机想看一眼时间。屏幕亮起的瞬间，他整个人却僵住了。晚上十点？他记得自已接取任务的时候是中午十二点左右。【叮！检测到已将宿主安全送回住所。】那个廉价的蓝白OA办公界面再次弹了出来，字体还是最普通的宋体。“系统，解释一下。”叶凛指着手机上的时间，语气不善。如果按照这个时间流速，他在神界待一天，地球岂不是要过去好几年？那还玩个屁。等他攒够钱想回来装个逼，估计连仇人的骨灰都找不到了。甚至可能回来发现自已已经被销户，坟头草都两米高了。【请宿主稍安勿躁。】系统的回复框弹得很快，带着一种公事公办的冷漠。【正常情况下，神界与凡间的时间流速比例为1:365（神界一日，人间一年）。】叶凛差点把手机砸了。一日一年？【按照正常情况，宿主打工期间蓝星的时间为1:1。】【但本次任务由于不可抗力因素影响，导致传送通道产生剧烈震荡，造成了时间流速的异常扰动。】【宿主在传送通道内的2.5分钟期间，蓝星的时间流速并未暂停，且时间流速以神界计算。】【郑重承诺：系统拥有强大的学习和修复能力，任何已知错误绝无可能发生第二次。】看到最后这一行加粗的红字，叶凛那颗悬着的心才算是放回了肚子里。这还差不多。只要主世界时间不走，那他在副本里哪怕待到天荒地老，回来也就是眨眼的事。这就意味着，他拥有了无限的时间去变强。而现实中的这帮人，还在按部就班地过着每一秒。这就是最大的外挂。“行吧，这次就算工伤，我不计较。”叶凛很大度地摆摆手。主要是计较也没用。这破系统连个投诉入口都没有。“结算工资吧。”【正在为您结算本次临时工任务……】【客户评价：五星好评】【客户留言：手法很专业，人也很懂事，可惜是个凡人，下次有机会，可以再来，也希望能帮我把没按到的地方按一下。】【——阿芙洛狄忒】【获得基础报酬：血汗钱*500，神力淬体。】【获得客户赠礼：晨曦玫瑰精油。】【正在进行神力淬体……】“唔！”叶凛还没来得及看清那个“神力淬体”的说明，一股热流毫无征兆的涌入全身。“什么玩意就开始了！！！”没有任何前戏，简单粗暴。如果说之前的推拿是享受，那现在的淬体就是酷刑。这根本不是什么温柔的强化。简直就像是有无数把微小的锤子，正在把他的每一块骨头敲碎了重组，把他的每一根肌肉纤维撕裂了再缝合！噼里啪啦！他的体内传出一阵阵爆豆般的脆响。皮肤表面渗出一层黑乎乎的油腻杂质，随即被晚风吹干，化作灰尘散去。那种脱胎换骨的剧痛来得快，去得也快。短短几秒钟后，叶凛感觉身体一轻，仿佛卸下了千斤重担。视力变得清晰得可怕，连百米外一只蚊子翅膀的纹路都看得一清二楚。握紧拳头，空气中竟然发出了轻微的爆鸣声。“卧槽……”叶凛感受着体内奔涌的力量，立刻打开了个人面板。【姓名：叶凛】【职位：临时工】【力量：1001】【体质：1001】【精神：1001】（正常成年男性标准为1，一阶信徒为1~10，宿主当前实力约为三阶巅峰觉醒者）看着那一连串的“1001”，叶凛的嘴角疯狂上扬。正常人是1，他是1001。千倍于常人的身体素质！“这个五星好评有什么用？除了触发奖励。”叶凛心情大好，继续问道。【五星好评是您晋升的关键指标。】系统界面切换，弹出一张类似职级晋升图的表格。【当前职位：临时工】【下一级职位：正式工】【当前进度：委托完成数（1/100），五星好评数（1/10）。】叶凛看着那个“100次委托”，只觉得两眼一黑。还要再给九十九个奇葩神明打工？上次是运气好，碰上了阿芙洛狄忒这种只要舒服就给好评的主。要是下次碰上赫菲斯托斯那种疯狗，或者什么吃人的妖怪，他有几条命够填？这些可都是诸天万界的神，哪怕蓝星灵气复苏了，都不是一个战力体系的。【特别提醒：职场如战场，评价很关键。】【若宿主收到差评，将直接抵消一次五星好评记录。】【若差评数量累计超过好评数量，宿主将被打上“劣质员工”标签。】【劣质员工接取的委托将自动锁定为“高风险、低回报、脏乱差”的惩罚性任务。】【如：清理九幽黄泉的下水道、给克苏鲁邪神修剪触手。】叶凛忍不住打了个寒颤。给克苏鲁修剪触手？那还是直接让他死了吧。“所以我不仅要完成任务，还得跪舔甲方爸爸，求他们给个好评？”叶凛咬牙切齿。【理解正确，顾客就是上帝（字面意思）。】“……”叶凛深吸一口气，强行压下想要骂娘的冲动。人在屋檐下，不得不低头。为了变强，为了不做那个随时可能被踩死的蝼蚁，这点委屈算什么。穿越前为了几百块的全勤奖，他连老板那秃头都能夸出花来。现在面对的是真神，夸两句怎么了？不寒碜。“打开商城。”叶凛搓了搓手，这才是重头戏。有了这500血汗钱，他总算能摆脱手无缚鸡之力的尴尬局面了。光幕一闪，一个琳琅满目的列表展现在眼前。只不过这商城的UI设计依旧充满了那种令人窒息的廉价感。就像是二十年前的网页游戏广告。但里面的商品，叶凛毫不怀疑这些不会是虚假宣传。【盘古精血（一滴）：来自顶级大三千世界，服用后肉身成圣，力破苍穹。】【售价：999999999血汗钱。】【太上老君的九转金丹：来自顶级大三千世界，服用后立地飞升，成就金仙道果。】【售价：888888888血汗钱。】【雷神之锤（姆乔尔尼尔）：来自大三千世界，神器，掌控雷霆。】【售价：50000000血汗钱。】叶凛面无表情地划过这些天价商品。看一眼都觉得被羞辱了。他直接拉到最底下的“杂货区”和“基础强化区”。这里的画风终于正常了一点。【洗髓丹：来自中三千世界，能排除体内杂质，提升资质。】【售价：1000血汗钱。】【基础格斗精通：来自小三千世界，瞬间掌握特种兵级别的格斗技巧。】【售价：200血汗钱。】【神位：来自大三千世界，可用于成神。】【售价：1000000血汗钱。】叶凛的手指在那个“神位”上停留了片刻。神位？？？只要攒够一百万，他就能在这个神话复苏的世界里，真正拥有属于自已的“编制”，从打工仔翻身做老板。虽然只是个九品芝麻官，但那也是神啊。“等着吧，迟早把你买下来。”叶凛暗暗发誓。他收回目光，看向自已那可怜巴巴的500余额。现在的当务之急，是解决生存问题。无论是面对即将到来的乱世，还是解决肚子饿的问题，都需要钱和力量。“系统，兑换属性点和现金。”【兑换比例说明：】【1血汗钱=1自由属性点（可加点力量、体质、精神）】【1血汗钱=10000元华夏币】“行，先给我换三万块钱。”叶凛大手一挥。【消耗3点血汗钱，兑换30,000蓝星币。】【交易成功。】“剩下497点……”叶凛看着余额，没有丝毫犹豫。“给我兑换300点自由属性，平均分配！”虽然神力淬体已经让他拥有了千倍常人的素质，但这玩意儿谁嫌多？在这个危机四伏的世界，多一点属性，就多一分保命的本钱。这种前期就开始攒钱的行为是最蠢的。哪怕是上一世，他都知道花钱去提升自已，然后换工资更高的工作。没道理有了系统就变成屯屯鼠。而剩下的197点血汗钱，留着应急，关键时候换点系统道具。【交易确认。】【强化完成。】那种熟悉的暖流再次扫过全身。虽然不如神力淬体给的那么多，但也让叶凛感觉到力量又上了一个台阶。最主要的是。不疼！叮——手机震动了一下。“您尾号1438的储蓄卡账户于22:10入账人民币元，当前余额元。”看着那一串零，叶凛的嘴角终于压不住了。有钱了。终于不用去吃拼好饭了。穿越过来十八年，这是他第一次感觉到口袋里有钱的踏实感。正准备关掉手机去觅食，一条消息却不合时宜地弹了出来。备注是：【170，42D，爱穿黑丝】
content_en: The white light dissipated, and a familiar damp musty smell entered the nose.There were the faint quarreling sounds of the couple next door, the gurgling sound of water flushing the toilet upstairs, and the tractor-like hum of the compressor in the old refrigerator.The sacred and depressing epic feeling was washed away in an instant.Ye Lin sat on the single bed that creaked whenever he turned over, feeling like he was in another world.Looking around, I saw a low-cost rental house with an area of ​​less than ten square meters. The walls were peeling off, but they were still kept clean.He touched his neck subconsciously.Still alive.Ye Lin took a deep breath and took out his phone to check the time.The moment the screen came on, he froze.Ten o'clock at night?He remembered that it was around 12 noon when he took the task.【bite!It is detected that the host has been returned safely to its residence.】The cheap blue and white OA office interface popped up again, and the font was still the most common Song Dynasty."System, please explain." Ye Lin pointed at the time on his phone with a bad tone.If he stayed in the God Realm for one day at this rate of time, wouldn't it take several years for the earth to pass?That's a lot of fun.When he saves enough money and wants to come back and show off, he may not even be able to find the ashes of his enemy.You may even come back to find that your account has been cancelled, and the grass on your grave is two meters high.[Host, please be patient and don’t be impatient.】The system's reply box bounces quickly, with a business-like indifference.[Under normal circumstances, the time flow rate ratio between the divine world and the mortal world is 1:365 (one day in the divine world, one year in the human world).] Ye Lin almost smashed his phone.One day and one year?[According to normal circumstances, Blue Star’s time during the host’s working period is 1:1.】【However, due to force majeure factors, this mission caused violent vibrations in the transmission channel, causing abnormal disturbances in the flow of time.】【During the 2.5 minutes that the host was in the transmission channel, Blue Star's time flow rate did not pause, and the time flow rate was calculated based on the God Realm.】【Solemn promise: The system has strong learning and repair capabilities, and any known error will never happen again.】Seeing the last line of bold red letters, Ye Lin's hanging heart finally returned to his stomach.That's pretty much it.As long as time does not pass in the main world, even if he stays in the dungeon until the end of time, he will only come back in the blink of an eye.This means that he has unlimited time to become stronger.But in reality, these people are still living every second step by step.This is the biggest cheat."Okay, I won't care if it's a work-related injury this time." Ye Lin waved his hand generously.Mainly it’s useless to care.This broken system doesn't even have a complaint portal."Settling wages." [Settling this temporary work task for you...] [Customer evaluation: five-star praise] [Customer message: The technique is very professional and the person is very sensible. It's a pity that he is a mortal. I can come again next time if I have a chance. I also hope that you can help me click on the places that I didn't touch.】【——Aphrodite】【Get basic reward: hard-earned money * 500, divine power tempering.】【Get a gift from a customer: Morning Rose Essential Oil.] [Divine Power Tempering is in progress...] "Hmm!" Before Ye Lin had time to read the description of "Divine Power Tempering" clearly, a stream of heat poured into his body without any warning."What the hell has started!!!" There was no foreplay, it was simple and crude.If the previous massage was enjoyment, then the current body tempering was torture.This is not gentle reinforcement at all.It was as if countless tiny hammers were breaking and reassembling every bone in his body, tearing apart and sewing every muscle fiber together!Crackling!There were bursts of crunching sounds like exploding beans in his body.A layer of dark, greasy impurities exuded from the surface of the skin, which was then dried by the evening breeze and turned into dust.The excruciating pain came and went away just as quickly.After just a few seconds, Ye Lin felt his body light up, as if a heavy burden had been lifted off him.His vision became frighteningly clear, and he could even clearly see the lines on the wings of a mosquito a hundred meters away.Clenching his fists, there was a slight explosion in the air."Fuck..." Ye Lin felt the power rushing through his body and immediately opened his personal panel.[Name: Ye Lin] [Position: Temporary worker] [Strength: 1001] [Physique: 1001] [Spirit: 1001] (The normal adult male standard is 1, the first-level believer is 1~10, the host's current strength is about the third-level peak awakener) Looking at the series of "1001", the corners of Ye Lin's mouth rose crazily.A normal person is 1 and he is 1001.A thousand times the physical fitness of ordinary people!"What's the use of this five-star review? Apart from triggering rewards." Ye Lin was in a good mood and continued to ask.[Five-star reviews are a key indicator for your promotion.】The system interface switches, and a table similar to a rank promotion chart pops up.[Current position: Temporary worker] [Next-level position: Regular worker] [Current progress: Number of commissions completed (1/100), number of five-star reviews (1/10).] Ye Lin looked at the "100 commissions" and felt his eyes darken.Do you want to work for ninety-nine weird gods again?Last time, I was lucky enough to meet someone like Aphrodite who would praise her as long as she felt comfortable.If he encounters a mad dog like Hephaestus or some man-eating monster next time, how many lives will he have to fill it?These are the gods of all the worlds. Even if the Blue Star spiritual energy is revived, they are not in the same combat power system.[Special reminder: The workplace is like a battlefield, and evaluation is critical.】【If the host receives a negative review, it will directly offset a five-star positive record.】【If the cumulative number of negative reviews exceeds the number of positive reviews, the host will be labeled as a "bad employee".】【Assignments accepted by inferior employees will be automatically locked into punitive tasks that are "high risk, low return, dirty and messy".】【For example: cleaning the sewers of Jiuyou Huangquan, trimming the tentacles of Cthulhu.] Ye Lin couldn't help but shudder.Trim Cthulhu's tentacles?Then just let him die."So not only do I have to complete the task, but I also have to kneel down and lick Party A's father and ask them for a good review?" Ye Lin gritted his teeth.[Understanding correctly, the customer is God (literally)."..." Ye Lin took a deep breath and suppressed the urge to curse.People under the eaves have to bow their heads.In order to become stronger, in order not to be that ant that could be trampled to death at any time, this grievance is nothing.Before time travel, he could even boast about his boss's bald head for a perfect attendance award of several hundred yuan.Now we are facing the true God, what’s wrong with a few words of praise?Not shabby."Open the mall." Ye Lin rubbed his hands, this was the highlight.With these 500 hard-earned money, he was finally able to get rid of the embarrassing situation of being powerless.The light screen flashed, and a dazzling list appeared in front of you.It's just that the UI design of this mall is still full of that suffocating sense of cheapness.It’s like a web game advertisement from twenty years ago.But for the products inside, Ye Lin had no doubt that they would not be false propaganda.[Pangu Essence and Blood (one drop): It comes from the top three thousand worlds. After taking it, the body becomes a saint and can break the sky.】【Price: 999999999 hard-earned money.】【Tai Shang Laojun's Nine-turn Golden Pill: It comes from the top three thousand worlds. After taking it, you will immediately ascend to the ground and achieve the Golden Immortal Dao Fruit.】【Price: 888888888 hard-earned money.】【Thor's Hammer (Mjolnir): From the Great Three Thousand Worlds, an artifact that controls thunder.】【Price: 50,000,000 hard-earned money.】Ye Lin looked at these sky-high-priced products with an expressionless face.One look at it makes me feel humiliated.He pulled directly to the "Grocery Area" and "Basic Strengthening Area" at the bottom.The style of painting here is finally a little more normal.[Marrow Cleansing Pill: From the Middle Three Thousand Worlds, it can remove impurities from the body and improve qualifications.】【Price: 1,000 hard-earned money.】【Basic combat proficiency: Coming from the world of Xiaosanqian, master the combat skills at the level of special forces in an instant.】【Price: 200 hard-earned money.】【Divine position: from the Three Thousand Worlds, can be used to become a god.】【Price: 1,000,000 hard-earned money.] Ye Lin's fingers stayed on that "divine position" for a moment.God's position???As long as he saves one million, he can truly have his own "establishment" in this world where myths are revived, and he can turn from a wage earner into a boss.Although he is only a ninth-grade official, he is still a god."Just wait, I will buy you sooner or later." Ye Lin vowed secretly.He withdrew his gaze and looked at his pitiful 500 balance.The top priority now is to solve the problem of survival.Whether you are facing the coming troubled times or solving the problem of hunger, you need money and strength."System, exchange attribute points and cash." [Explanation of exchange ratio:] [1 hard-earned money = 1 free attribute point (can add some strength, physique, spirit)] [1 hard-earned money = 10,000 yuan of Chinese coins] "Okay, give me 30,000 yuan first." Ye Lin waved his hand.[Consume 3 points of hard-earned money to exchange for 30,000 blue star coins.】【Transaction successful."There are 497 points left..." Ye Lin looked at the balance without any hesitation."Exchange me for 300 points of free attributes and distribute them evenly!" Although the divine tempering body has given him a thousand times the qualities of an ordinary person, who can find this too much?In this crisis-ridden world, the more attributes you have, the more money you can save your life.This kind of behavior of starting to save money in the early stage is the stupidest thing.Even in his previous life, he knew how to spend money to improve himself and then change to a job with a higher salary.There is no reason that if you have a system, you will become a hamster.The remaining 197 points of hard-earned money are reserved for emergencies and used to replace some system props at critical times.[Transaction confirmed.】【Reinforcement completed.】That familiar warmth swept through the body again.Although it was not as much as the Divine Power Tempering Body gave, it still made Ye Lin feel that her strength had reached a new level.The main thing is.It doesn't hurt!Ding - the phone vibrated."Your savings card account with the last number 1438 was credited with RMB yuan at 22:10, and the current balance is RMB yuan." Looking at the string of zeros, Ye Lin finally couldn't hold back the corners of his mouth.Got money.Finally, I no longer have to go out to eat.Eighteen years after traveling back in time, this was the first time he felt the security of having money in his pocket.Just as he was about to turn off his phone and go look for food, a message popped up at an inappropriate time.The note is: [170, 42D, loves to wear black stockings]
